chapters.title: 5m CLOSED DOWN
chapters.text: The 5-minute candle closes DOWN after an UP one: the middle timeframe turns first, a notch on the 5m lane. The 15m lane still reads UP. 5m FLIP rail: 26,562.25.

chapters.title: 15m CLOSED DOWN
chapters.text: The 15-minute Heikin-Ashi candle closes DOWN after an UP one: the slow timeframe turns. The A mark goes over the high; the 15m FLIP rail steps to 26,532.00.

chapters.title: FIRM
chapters.text: The chart's candle closes 2.1u past its flip level, two units or more: the tier reads FIRM and the panel candle takes the strong colour. 5m and 15m both read DOWN: 3 OF 3 DOWN.
